Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

objectives.text:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

objectives.text: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.

objectives.text: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

objectives.text: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.

accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!

accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.

objectives.text: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.

accept.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.

complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, but that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.

objectives.text: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.

complete.text: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.

accept.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.

objectives.text: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

objectives.text: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...

objectives.text: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: You are back? And... alone?

accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.

objectives.text: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.

objectives.text: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.

accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.

complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.

objectives.text: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.

progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.

accept.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.

objectives.text: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.

accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.

objectives.text: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.

accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?

objectives.text: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>

accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

objectives.text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

accept.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.

objectives.text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.

accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

complete.text:
Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid the High Order?

I suppose we will see.

objectives.text: Find Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.

complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

objectives.text: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?

accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $n. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

objectives.text: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.

accept.text: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.

complete.text:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.

Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.

While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.

objectives.text: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.

accept.text:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.

complete.text: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain, you notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>

objectives.text: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.

accept.text:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.

complete.text:
That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!

Thank you for your service to the High Order, $c.

objectives.text: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.

progress.text: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.

accept.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

complete.text:
The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.

<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>

...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.

accept.text:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.

complete.text:
It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.

Unfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.

$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.

objectives.text: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.

progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?

accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

complete.text:
Th... thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.

I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.

objectives.text: Keep searching for Fillion Flamebreeze.

accept.text:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.

complete.text: Thank you again, $N.

objectives.text: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.

progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.

accept.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

complete.text:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

objectives.text: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.

complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.

objectives.text: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the Windshapers and High Order in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.

complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

complete.text:
Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?

There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

objectives.text: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, his mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $n.

complete.text:
It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for our vanguard to depart.

objectives.text: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.

accept.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

complete.text:
Winds bless me, this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, $c.

objectives.text: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.

accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.

objectives.text: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

progress.text: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.

accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

complete.text: Thanks $c. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text:
These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village. 

With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.

accept.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.

objectives.text: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: <Vayn nods at you.>

accept.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

complete.text:
Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?

objectives.text: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?

complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.

objectives.text: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: Hello there, $c.

accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.

objectives.text: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, it's clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>

objectives.text: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?

objectives.text: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

progress.text: What news from the western watch?

accept.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

complete.text:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.

objectives.text: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.

accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.

objectives.text: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated $1oa Enchanted Skyhoppers.

accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

complete.text:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.

objectives.text: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: What beautiful things did you bring me?

accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

complete.text: <Valennia looks gravely wounded.>

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.

objectives.text: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.

accept.text:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.

complete.text: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.

objectives.text: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.

complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.

objectives.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.

accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.

complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

objectives.text: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.

complete.text:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.

objectives.text: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
Greetings, young $n. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.

complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.

objectives.text: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.

accept.text:
A moment if you will, $n. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

objectives.text: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Lady's Tear Moss.

progress.text: Have you found the Lady's Tear?

accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

complete.text: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

complete.text:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $c.

I will hold onto them for safekeeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.

accept.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

complete.text:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.

objectives.text: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

progress.text: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?

accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob and grits her teeth, letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'Aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.

objectives.text: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal $1oa druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

objectives.text: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $n. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

complete.text:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>

I--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows' sacrifice be in vain.

objectives.text: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.

accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

accept.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.

accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.

objectives.text: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

progress.text: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $c, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.

accept.text:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

complete.text:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.  

As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

objectives.text: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

accept.text:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

objectives.text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

accept.text:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.

complete.text: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.

objectives.text:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.

accept.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.

complete.text: You're back already! Impressive speed, $N!

objectives.text:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.

complete.text:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.

progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?

accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Dalaran Wizards and $2oa Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.

accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.

complete.text: Well met!

objectives.text: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

objectives.text: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

complete.text: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

objectives.text: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.

complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the Scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

objectives.text: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>

complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

objectives.text: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.

accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

objectives.text: Speak with Faruza in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Speak with Mendalass Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!

objectives.text: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

accept.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine. Be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken such as ourselves, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Sickly Refugees and $2oa Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>

complete.text:
Thanks for delivering this, pal.

Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! 

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

objectives.text: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.

progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.

complete.text:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.

progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?

accept.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.

complete.text: Well done, $c. With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.

progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.

accept.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.

complete.text: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...

objectives.text: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.

progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?

accept.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.

complete.text:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.

objectives.text: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.

progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?

accept.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.

complete.text:
Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth are in serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.

As ever, their own dogmatic hubris takes precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.

objectives.text: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
